name: Boston
limitations: Eight dimensions/31 subpillars reviewed, not fully measured. All eight now conditional60, total60; withdrawing necessary GSS class/geography/2025-to-cutoff/usual net-protection inference restores unknown and51–66 without a complete total. Other seven literal judgments and their original fiscal/clinical/source-window/quality/spatial/eligibility/payment assumptions remain. Neither charges nor hospital contact prove convictions or lasting recovery; an unnamed hotel is unlocated. All9031 and new/unmatched competitors retained; no global ranking eligibility.

dimensions.rationale: Implemented coastal facilities and usable heat-cooling entrances support major protection; effect and whole-area reach remain unmeasured. Plans are not completed works. Priority review adds actual regional cold-spell bulk-power operation as limited weather-continuity evidence, not all-household protection or independent backup.
dimensions.assumption: Reviewed protection usually works, persists and reasonably applies to the ordinary resident and FUA; unreviewed hazards do not represent broader unmitigated failure. Reject necessary effectiveness, reach or representativeness assumptions to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Recent first-party BPD records connect reported organized exploitation with actual intervention and, in a separate minor-trafficking case, delivered hospital evaluation/care. Read with the retained local and cross-agency strategic context, these support conditional60 through a limited usual net-protection judgment, not a measured all-FUA low-incidence or recovery rate.
dimensions.assumption: S01 records coordinated advertising, prices, logistics and suspected trafficking at two Brighton apartments, three women identified and an alleged operator arrested; it does not prove all commercial sex is coercive, convictions or lasting victim protection. S02 records alleged control/transport of a15-year-old, actual police contact and hospital care; its unnamed hotel is not assigned a7347coordinate. Accept alleged organized exploitation as relevant to GSS, actual local/shared intervention as reasonably representative of usable ordinary protection and usually manageable remaining real impact, and2025 practice continuing to the2026cutoff. The known interventions interrupt the reported operation and connect the minor to care; broader ordinary net-protection/limited lower-impact direction is an explicit revocable inference, not absence of reported events or a case-count estimate. Retained JTTF/Logan/cross-agency and judicial context is not newly reacquired or reauthenticated. No new regional or strategic impact rate is claimed. Refuse a necessary class, geographic, temporal or net-protection inference and restore unknown.

alternativeRationales.40: Requires actual important coercion, threat effects or key protection/channel disruption remaining after mitigation; no majority/dominance/collapse requirement. Reported victims or missing followup alone do not select40.
alternativeRationales.80: Stronger credible multiple-layer real protection, ordinary access and recovery; no zero-events/all-node perfection gate.
alternativeRationales.null: Fair if the new scoped intervention and retained context are insufficient to infer usual net protection across the three GSS meanings; neither raw loss nor absence of perfect population data is the reason.

dimensions.rationale: Actual records-service closure improvements, implemented workflows, completed projects and delivered digital assistance support execution. Police exclusions, fees, group gaps and unmeasured crisis recovery remain limitations. Priority review adds delivered24-hour ambulance capacity and actual cross-provider adaptation after Carney closure; transport and care gaps persist.
dimensions.assumption: Major institutions usually work for ordinary residents; scoped execution/mitigation reasonably represents the FUA and persists. Reports with unverified first publication require a withdrawable pre-cutoff availability assumption. Reject continuity, representativeness or adequacy to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Actual treated water/pipe replacement, food warehousing/distribution and cold-spell bulk-power operations support usual necessities. High-risk lead samples, weighted regional food/heating hardship and incomplete relief remain; neither county/state surveys nor aid throughput represent all7347 median-income citizens. Report text/figure percentage conflicts are retained.
dimensions.assumption: Accept limited local/provider and regional operating evidence as reasonably representative of normally accessible affordable necessities for7347 ordinary citizens, continuing through cutoff; actual assistance mitigates without eliminating hardship and remaining burdens are judged not to dominate usual necessary supply. More material unrelieved food/water/energy/affordability constraints could40; effective affordable multiple-source/shared-shock mitigation80. Reject geography, historical publication/continuation, target-profile affordability or residual-impact inference to restore unknown. Do not require perfect household bills or interpret missing evidence as deprivation.

dimensions.rationale: BMC risk-adjusted comparison categories for multiple necessary conditions, original statewide insurance/access survey, neighboring-provider admissions and delivered24-hour ambulance capacity after Carney closure support operating necessary care. Displayed mortality percentages are national comparisons, not BMC local rates. Closure-related travel/pressure, PCP and affordability gaps remain; transport-time summary and subgroup increases are not forced to agree.
dimensions.assumption: Accept scoped care quality/comparison, actual referral/emergency adaptation and usual active qualified insurance as reasonably representative of ordinarily appropriate timely affordable necessary care through cutoff, with workable alternatives and bearable uncovered/upfront costs. Statewide reported cost-related unmet care is not the FUA median-profile rate, but remains serious counterevidence; judge residual access/continuity/payment problems not a dominant persistent inadequately mitigated necessary-treatment constraint. If they do form an important bottleneck,40; stronger appropriate results and effective affordable backup80. Reject spatial/profile applicability, time/availability, usual quality/eligibility/timeliness/payment or residual-impact assumptions to restore unknown; no perfect bill or universal stress-test prerequisite.

dimensions.rationale: Credible human/regulatory evidence connects with the provider ATP account of over 1000 patients receiving lecanemab/donanemab, plus a scoped retrospective safety cohort. Counts are not local-resident prevalence, all-drug patient splits, healthy-person lifespan gains or proof of complete safety adherence.
dimensions.assumption: Accept local-delivery inference, limited disease-pathway representativeness, continuing appropriate monitoring including updated MRI requirements, and ordinary eligible residents generally obtaining and affording suitable care. Author affiliations and approximate reference points are not treatment coordinates; reject any necessary assumption to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: MIT actual licensing/startup activity and local digital use/assistance establish scoped capability alongside actual staffing, affordability and skills constraints. Delivered devices and facilities are retained; post-cutoff October11 publication totals are excluded.
dimensions.assumption: Reviewed constraints remain material after delivered mitigation and reasonably apply to ordinary residents/FUA through the cutoff. This is a provisional constraints/representativeness judgment, not a cap based on unknown high-tier evidence. Reject necessary applicability/continuity to restore unknown; stronger multi-producer capacity, broad usability and mitigation could support 80.

dimensions.rationale: Actual Logan ground access, a limited remote-terminal pilot and public communications connect with shared conditional US-citizen residence-application and account-transfer paths. Trips are not unique residents or independent airport alternatives.
dimensions.assumption: Ordinary residents generally have suitable eligibility, funds, accounts and usable accessible communications; normal pathways continue across the FUA. June pilot opening does not prove every service still operates in October. Reject any necessary usability, affordability, continuity or spatial assumption to restore unknown.
